info.title: About the numbers
items: Times are assumed to spread exponentially around each country’s average.
Averages are reported daily minutes per year (GWI / DataReportal). Missing years stay blank.
{share} of each population is assumed to use social media.
Generations are counted as of {year}. Age structure and weighting are rough estimates.
Health data: EU adolescents, projected onto ages 10–19.
Reasons: global survey of internet users aged 16–64, multiple answers.
The timeline line averages the countries reporting that year. Population stays at today’s level.
